content.short: eUTxO.org is a visual Cardano blockchain explorer for transactions, blocks, network activity, and data.
content.description: eUTxO.org is a visual blockchain explorer for Cardano that presents transactions, blocks, and network activity in a more graphical way than traditional explorer tables. The project aims to help users understand the extended UTxO model by making Cardano data easier to inspect visually. Users can dive into transaction and block details while following how value moves through the network. eUTxO.org is useful for learners, developers, and community members who want a clearer visual perspective on Cardano.
